parsed.summary: The PR adds joblib to the dependencies listed in show_versions, which is a necessary change. However, it lacks documentation updates and may not be fully tested.

issues.description: The PR does not update the documentation to reflect the addition of joblib to the dependencies listed in show_versions.
The PR does not include any tests to verify that joblib is correctly listed in the dependencies when sklearn version is > 0.20.
